meta.title: A blank end time cannot be saved
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

plan.title: Blank end time cannot be saved

steps.note: Open the event create screen to reach the schedule drawer.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create flow.
Apply a pricing template so scheduling becomes available.
Add the minimum line item required for the schedule controls.
Complete the pricing sheet so the create form is valid enough to open scheduling.
Open the schedule drawer, matching the test setup.
Clear the end time field as required by the case.
Attempt to save the blank end time.
Assert that the app shows a field-level validation message for the blank end time.
Assert that saving was blocked client-side and no request containing a null end time was sent.
